_rationale: California per-state profile (graduated 1–13.3%) with the round-3 fix that lets the state std deduction ($5,540) absorb into LTCG when ordinary income is below the deduction. Refreshed for the CA 2024 bracket data (FTB tax-year-2024 thresholds; prior data was 2023 figures mislabeled 2024). With $0 ordinary, the stacked walk runs CA 2024 single brackets over (w − $5,540): 1%·10,756 + 2%·14,743 + 4%·14,746 + 6%·15,285 ≈ $1,909. Solving 50,000 = w − 0.15w − stateLTCG(w) iteratively → w ≈ $61,070. Federal LTCG = $9,160; State LTCG = $1,909 (was $1,992 under the stale 2023 thresholds). Balance year 1 = 1,000,000 − 61,070 = $938,930.
